title: Base template with conditional navigation
description: The base template (base.html) provides the shared page scaffold: title block, static CSS link, a navigation bar that switches between Register/Log In (anonymous) and username/Log Out (authenticated) based on g.user, and a flash-message display section. All other templates extend this base.
spec:
1. Verify flaskr/templates/base.html defines an HTML scaffold with a title block ('{% block title %}'), a CSS link to static/style.css, and a content block.
2. Verify the nav element conditionally renders: when g.user is set, shows the username span and a Log Out link (url_for 'auth.logout'); when g.user is None, shows Register and Log In links.
3. Verify a flash-message loop renders get_flashed_messages() inside a .flash div.
4. Verify all templates (register, login, index, create, update) extend base.html and populate its blocks.
